Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Everett for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 5 of them free. New in this update: Santa's Sock-Hop Tree Lighting at Imagine Children's Museum (November 28), A Winter to Imagine at Imagine Children's Museum (from November 28) and Deck the Boughs at Evergreen Arboretum and Gardens (from December 1). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Everett families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.
